test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

Hiking across an Himalayas is going to be a tough task for a beginner.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the article "**an**" before the term "**Himalayas**."
 
• The correct article to use before a word starting with a consonant sound is "**a**."
 
• The correct phrase should be "**a Himalayas**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 4** of the sentence.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

**Correct Sentence:** *"Hiking across** a Himalayas** is going to be a tough task for a beginner."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "task for a beginner."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 2: "Hiking across"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "going to be a tough"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
